body: JD_AtTheTop, ign, got banned for force filed , it has been almost 4 months since I have been banned and, I am starting to get very mad, I have got back on all the servers I have been banned on, other than this server. Everyone understood the issue, except for Avicus. I am here for one last push before I give up on he Avicus Network as a hole. ( please read Appeal before hand)

replies.author: hpux
replies.body:
Hello,

Because you have been banned for quite a long time, in addition to lack of evidence, I will appeal your infraction and give you the benefit of the doubt. However, if you are banned again, your chances of becoming unbanned will decrease to a minimal, if not 0%.

Regards,
Dutchis
Avicus Network Administrator
